newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian avg lending rate falls to 8.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian avg lending rate falls to 8.5 pct.

text.p: Croatia's average money market rate dropped to 8.5 percent on Thursday from 10 percent, weighed down by call money loans.
Trade volume doubled to 55.5 million kuna from Wednesday's 22.4 million.
Fresh deals accounted for 50.7 million kuna and were mostly call money deals granted at 7.0, 8.0 and 9.0 percent.
Term rates ranged between 7.0 percent for rolled over interbank and insurer funds and 18 percent for three-month interbank money.
Kuna midrates for Friday firmed to 6.5200 against the dollar and eased to 3.5578 against the German mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb newsroom +385 1 455 7075
